title: Nameservers
desc: The shared nameserver pair your customers delegate their domains to. Once set, customers are shown these instead of an IP/A record.
suggested: The values below were guessed from your panel domain and are NOT saved yet. Verify them and save.
migrate_confirm: NS records and SOA primary NS of all domains will be updated to the current nameserver pair and zones rewritten. Continue?
hint_a_record: These hostnames must have A records pointing to this server's IP in your own DNS, otherwise no customer domain will resolve.
